sewer-t10-stress.label: Sewer stress, T10
sewer-t10-stress.note: Diagnosis layer from the Resilience Atlas (PICBA’06 / BCASA). Traces in this repo are simplified corridors, not the plan drawings. PDISBA on BCNROC is CC-BY-NC-ND — cited, not republished.

resccue-hotspots.label: 14 urban flood hotspots
resccue-hotspots.note: Names follow the Resilience Atlas list of 14 critical points (PDISBA’19 / RESCCUE).

buried-streams.label: Buried streams and rieres
buried-streams.note: Hairlines are ICGC RIER_LN. Named avenues are simplified traces. Red dots sit where a RESCCUE critical point lies on one of those streams. Not taken from the October reports.

retention-tanks.label: Stormwater tanks
retention-tanks.note: Rambla de Prim capacity (94,000 m³) and the count of 15 existing tanks come from the July 2025 city press note. Points are placed on the named places, not surveyed chambers.

slopes-torrents.label: Slopes and torrents
slopes-torrents.note: Outlines are simplified neighborhood boundaries for Collserola-facing areas, not INUNCAT flood contours.

proof-oct2026.label: October 2026 observed impacts
proof-oct2026.note: Observed only. Not mixed into the atlas layers.

relief.label: Terrain height, ICGC
relief.note: The height on each card is the 2022 AMB lidar terrain model, read at the marked place. Map contours are traced from the ICGC 5 m terrain model, which is coarser. The fall is the drop to the lowest ground 250 m away. Not a flood depth.

rainfall-observed.label: Rainfall, observed mention only
rainfall-observed.note: Quoted in About as an observation from 3 October 2026. Not a layer and not a forecast.

weather-days.label: Daily rainfall, Meteocat XEMA
weather-days.note: Daily accumulated rainfall at Barcelona – el Raval, Observatori Fabra and Zona Universitària. The map uses the highest of the three. The file publishes with about two days of delay.

terrain-pooling.label: Where terrain pools water
terrain-pooling.note: Terrain diagnostic from the ICGC 5 m terrain model, read as terrain-RGB tiles at zoom 12 and coarsened to about 143 m cells. Priority-flood depression depth and slope only. No rain, no drains, not a simulation.
